pcb.geometry: Actual unrouted tscircuit PCB and its component placement; supplied component OBJ models where available. Generic or datasheet-derived bodies remain approximate.
pcb.routing: No copper routing. Wires in this assembly are external connection illustrations.

peltier.description: HiLetgo TEC1-12706 2-pack; the board drives one module
peltier.geometry: Amazon listing dimensional envelope, not manufacturer CAD. Ceramic plates and core are visual approximations; lead routing, diameter and length are illustrative. Confirm purchased samples before mechanical manufacture.

usbCable.description: Cable Matters 201440, USB-C to USB-C, 240 W / 5 A cable, 1 m option
usbCable.geometry: Connection illustration. Only a short cable segment and the board-side plug are shown. Manufacturer does not publish plug/jacket CAD or dimensions; these are indicative, not fit-qualified geometry. The charger-side end is omitted.
usbCable.electricalRating: Up to 48 V / 5 A. This board uses SPR USB-C PD, not the cable's 240 W EPR capability.

display.description: Waveshare 0.91inch OLED Module, SKU 14657, SSD1306, 128 x 32 pixels
display.geometry: Manufacturer-published PCB outline and active-area dimensions. PCB thickness, glass package envelope, connector placement and height are approximations; no official 3D file found. Floating position illustrates an external module and does not specify a mounting system.

displayCable.description: Adafruit 3568, 4-pin JST-PH female/female cable, 150 mm / 26 AWG
displayCable.geometry: Connection illustration with simplified PHR-4 mating housings based on the JST drawing. Harness path, wire diameters, connector details and exact slack are illustrative, not official CAD. The displayed path is a partial segment; excess cable slack is omitted.
displayCable.electricalRequirement: Pin 1 to pin 1, 2 to 2, 3 to 3, 4 to 4. Verify cable continuity and manufacturer pin numbering before powering. This custom OLED pinout is not the STEMMA device pinout; wire colors do not indicate these signal names. The included Waveshare cable is not assumed to mate to the board.

officialCadAttempts.result: Manufacturer offers CAD through TraceParts; no downloadable mesh obtained. Board uses the exact-part EasyEDA supplier mesh, which is not claimed to be manufacturer-authored.
Manufacturer-linked CAD export requires registered authorization. Use TI RYQ0021A drawing-derived 5 x 3 x 1 mm maximum-height package envelope where no supplier mesh is present.

assemblyLimitations: Connection and packaging visualization only. No heatsink, cold plate, clamping mechanism or thermal interface is specified by this assembly. Do not power a bare Peltier without an appropriate hot-side thermal assembly.
